parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the workflow instance.

parameters.name: filters[activity_types][]
parameters.description: Optional activity filter (`comments`, `attachments`). When present, the response only includes timeline rows that match the filter. **Future step events are not included** when this filter is used ...

name.description: Display name of the workflow template for this instance

status.description: Urgency-derived status for the workflow instance, or null when urgency has not been set.

started_at.description: Timestamp when the workflow instance was started

ended_at.description: Timestamp when the workflow instance ended

blocked_reason.description: Human-readable reason when status is blocked

blocked_is_retriable.description: True when a blocked instance may recover by refreshing the workflow.

current_step_index.description: Zero-based index within the history array pointing to the current active step, or null when inactive

history.description: Ordered list of history events for the workflow instance
